The Roughneck Flooring and Tile Remover Bar and Scraper is a 13" (330mm) heavy-duty wrecking bar, expertly designed for efficient removal of various floor coverings and trim. Its robust carbon steel flat shaft is heat-treated and hardened, ensuring exceptional durability and strength for demanding tasks. Featuring a self-prying wedge and chamfered edges, this tool effortlessly slips into tight gaps, making it ideal for renovation projects involving wood flooring, carpet tiles, ceramic tiles and much more. A metal end cap built into the handle allows the tool to be struck with a hammer, delivering additional impact when breaking adhesive bonds or lifting particularly resistant sections. The integrated scraper and comfort grip enhance versatility and user experience, making it a reliable choice for professional floor fitters and builders. A black powder-coated finish provides rust and corrosion resistance, extending the tool's lifespan.
